- Background: Foundational context is centered on evaluating AI agent frameworks and automated content generation pipelines. Current focus is on establishing baseline capabilities, understanding user expectations for AI-assisted structuring, and tracking the evolution of technical exploration preferences over time.

- [context | 0.95] 正在执行系统配置数据分析项目，专门提取 syssetting 表（Type=1）的“新鲜周期”配置数据，查询日期区间严格限定为 2024 年 1 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日。

- [preference | 0.80] Prefers using sub-agents to execute SQL queries.
